recap: Deleted 90+ dead scripts, __pdf/ dir, dead aliases (cpv, mvv, tr?, trl), remark config + npm deps, and fixed stale cheat-sheet reference
Added Script/Autoloaded Function/Binary Wrapper glossary entries, CLAUDE.md rules for script vs function, and rename map covering 30+ scripts
Added missingDocComment zsh-lint rule: checks line 1 (autoloaded) or line 2 (script) for doc comment, skips __lib/__rules/__tests__ dirs
Created bin-zsh dispatcher script, deleted colorize-bin and git-directory-root-bin wrappers (no active callers)

Migrated audio-duration, mic2txt-autosubmit-mode-toggle, mic2txt-language-toggle to autoloaded functions; updated Ubuntu keybindings and Argos configs to use bin-zsh; fixed pre-existing lint errors in Argos configs
Migrated 10 video/media scripts to autoloaded functions, rewrote video-has-sound from Ruby to ZSH, renamed mp4min to mp4-min, fixed compdef typo video-increase-volume

Migrated 7 image scripts to autoloaded functions, rewrote image-orientation from Ruby to ZSH, renamed pngmask to png-mask-create (collision with existing png-mask), removed jpgmin alias, updated compdef

Rewrote 4 Ruby scripts to ZSH, migrated 6 file-renaming scripts to 5 autoloaded functions in rename/ domain (rename-to-directory, rename-prefix, rename-clean, rename-capitalize, rename-sequential); merged rename-fat32 + filename-valid into single rename-clean with iconv transliteration

Migrated 16 git scripts to autoloaded functions, rewrote git-submodule-create from Ruby to ZSH, fixed submodule aliases using wrong 'git commit-submodule' form, moved git-submodule-list test to autoload location
Created _git-remote-rename positional completer (remotes for 1st arg only), split git-remote-rename out of shared _git-remotes compdef group
Created git-submodule-list-raw (▮-separated output), refactored git-submodule-list and complete-git-submodules to delegate to it, added git-commit-submodule to compdef
Created git-stash-list-raw/list/complete-git-stash, added _git-stash compdef for git-stash-apply, fixed create (save→push) and apply (apply+drop→pop with optional selector)

Created git-commit-list-raw, fzf-powered complete-git-commits with colorized reload, complete-git-files-deleted, made git-file-resurrect robust (guards, absolute paths, uncommitted deletions), added compdef mappings

Added input validation to git-remote-rename: arg count guard, source-exists/dest-not-exists checks via git-remote-exists, colorized error messages, success confirmation; pre-rename colorize to avoid stale remote lookup
Migrated git-issue-list and git-pullrequest-list cache writes from .git/oroshi_*_count to $OROSHI_TMP_FOLDER/github/<project>/, matching the existing prompt cache pattern
Migrated 9 docker scripts to autoloaded functions (container-list, image-build/push, images-remote-refresh, oroshi-commit/list/run, run, run-interactive); no external callers to update

Migrated 5 FZF scripts (ctrl-shift-o, fzf-apt-packages, fzf-git-files-dirty-stageable, fzf-git-files-dirty, fzf-js-test) to autoloaded functions; preview/reload commands use bin-zsh for fzf subprocess access
Migrated json-count, json-filter, jsonl2json to autoloaded functions with tests; no external callers to update

Migrated 7 ruby/gem scripts to autoloaded functions (bundle-install/update, gem-install/uninstall/update, bundle-install-in-progress, has-ruby); fixed has-ruby bug checking commands[zsh] instead of commands[ruby]; no external callers to update

Migrated 3 system/desktop scripts to autoloaded functions (better-keepass, dconf-watch, statusbar-clock); deleted cpu-percent and ram-percent (duplicates of existing sys-cpu/sys-ram); updated Ubuntu keybinding and Kitty statusbar Python to use bin-zsh

Deleted statusbar.py, 3 statusbar scripts, statusbar-clock function+tests, removed statusbar imports/calls from Kitty tab bar, removed 7 statusbar icon definitions, simplified pick_tabs to use full screen width

Migrated 6 text/encoding scripts to autoloaded functions: url2host (Ruby→ZSH), sort-by-length (Bash→ZSH), base64decode→base64-decode, base64encode→base64-encode, xml2json, zsh2json; updated NeoVim keybinding to bin-zsh

Migrated 12 misc dev tool scripts to autoloaded functions (fork, install-deb, is-older, css-fix, python-version, node-module-install, lua-lint-selene, lua-test-path, plan-badge, ralph-is-running, review-blog-start); rewrote version-compare from Ruby to ZSH as version-is-newer, renamed algolia-download to algolia-index-download; updated 3 Bash install scripts and NeoVim css.lua to use bin-zsh

Migrated 16 misc personal scripts to autoloaded functions: rcp, rmv, better-rmdir, website-download, rar-repair, kindle-screensaver, switch-extract, isomount (ZSH); my-ip, ping-average, file-count, unmark (Bash→ZSH); cesoir, font-exists, html2pdf (Ruby→ZSH); kitty-tab-window-count moved to kitty/ domain; kindle-screensaver updated to use magick (ImageMagick 7)
